description: The Earthquake Engineering Research Institute published a virtual reconnaissance report describing impacts attributed to the 15 August 2026 Ende, Indonesia earthquake. Its VERT team assembled publicly available information from the first 48 hours, covering buildings, housing, schools, transport and utilities, alongside emergency response and secondary hazards. This information source supports initial infrastructure-impact assessment and planning for field reconnaissance. DesignSafe identifies a PDF report and provides public repository access at no stated charge under Creative Commons Attribution; the licence version is unspecified. The authors explicitly report limited ground-truthing. Event details and reported impacts were not independently verified. The version-two filename contains a date that differs from the title, so users should check the report before citing its chronology. The related DesignSafe Data Depot record describes the repository.
